title: ACR MCP run_operation Request v1
description: Input for the run_operation tool. Names one allowlisted operation and its variables. You send no query text. The organization always comes from your credential, never from a variable.

operation.description: The operation name exactly as data_catalog lists it, for example compoundingRisk, hotspots, securityAlerts, catalogValues or capacityForecasts. An unknown name is refused.

variables.description: The operation's variables, shaped as data_catalog shows their paths, for example {"filter":{"breakout":"REPO","repoIds":["repository:..."]}}. Repository and team ids are canonical ids taken from find_subjects or from a response: never build one. A variable that is not listed for the operation is refused. Omit it for an operation that needs none.

max_bytes.description: Upper bound for the size of the returned data in bytes. 0 or absent means the default, 32768; the largest is 262144. Data over the bound is refused with response_budget, never cut: ask for less (a shorter window, a lower limit) instead.
